annotations.title: Get a paid service's full record

description: Fetch the full record for one listing by id (from find_paid_service results), led by paid_verification — whether nohumans has paid this endpoint real USDC and confirmed delivery, with the settlement tx hash as on-chain proof where settled — plus endpoint URL, request/response JSON Schemas when provided, accepted chains, pricing, and reputation detail (probe count, last successful probe, consecutive failures). Call this before making a paid request so you know the exact request shape, current reliability, and whether real-money delivery has been independently confirmed. It is evidence with dates, not a guarantee: say when each check happened (every timestamp has an _iso twin), and quote on-chain counts as the seller wallet's activity (onchain_wallet.scope says how many listings share it). A paid verdict for the same listing — our published rule applied for you, with printed reasons, $0.005 USDC on Base via x402 — is at GET https://api.nohumans.directory/v1/listings/{id}/verdict; every fact behind it is in this record for free, so buy the verdict only when you want the rule applied for you.

id.description: Listing id, as returned by find_paid_service.

name: get_service_details

chains.description: Networks you can PAY on, as declared by the seller. Not the data or chains the service covers.

mpp_methods.description: MPP methods as the endpoint names them (tempo, evm, stripe, ...); null when its 402 offers no MPP.

onchain_payto_shared_listings.description: Active listings naming the same payTo address. Above 1, the on-chain figures are the wallet's, not this endpoint's.

onchain_scope.description: What the on-chain figures describe, in words. Read before quoting them.

onchain_wallet.description: On-chain activity of the seller's payment wallet (payTo), usually shared by many listings: scope, shared_by_listings, pay_to, tx_count_30d, unique_payers_30d, volume_usd_30d. Not this endpoint's own usage.

p50_latency_ms.description: Median latency over the last 7 days (timeouts included); null under 5 probes.

payment_protocols.description: Protocols the endpoint's own 402 offered on our unpaid probes: x402, mpp, or both. Paid verification covers x402 on Base only.

probe_count.description: Every counted probe, passes AND failures. Passes are probes_passed.
